name: Webhook Payload Builder API
shortDescription: Build a signed webhook envelope + ready-to-send request for Stripe, GitHub, Shopify, Slack, Svix, or generic HMAC
description: Agent-native signed-webhook envelope builder computed with real cryptography (Node crypto HMAC), not a language model. /build takes a provider preset, an event_type, the payload data, and a signing secret, then serializes a canonical {id,type,created,data} JSON body, computes the HMAC signature, and returns the provider-formatted signature header(s), the timestamp and idempotency message id used, the exact signed string, and a complete ready-to-send request spec (method, url, headers, body). Supports Stripe (t=…,v1=…), GitHub (sha256=…), Shopify (base64), Slack (v0:ts:body), Svix/standard-webhooks (id.ts.body), and generic HMAC. Ideal for integration tests, replays, fixtures, and local development. The one-call /lookup adds a reasoning object and send guidance. Results are deterministic so confidence is always 1.0; secrets are never stored.
